label: Full Redrob challenge output
note: This public asset contains the validator-ready top-100 output produced after ranking the full Redrob dataset. It does not bundle the private raw candidate file into the browser.

learnedRerank.message: Learned reranker scored 100 finalist candidates with Hugging Face Space.

biasAudit.summary: Bias guardrail applied; proxy distribution still needs human review.
mitigations: scores are built from job evidence before logistics signals
location and availability are capped as feasibility signals, not quality signals
proxy-heavy profiles lose lift when technical and production evidence is weak
tie-breaks use candidate id only for deterministic ordering
warnings: The Redrob file does not expose protected attributes such as gender, caste, religion, disability, or race. Sifter audits observable proxy fields instead.
5 proxy groups need human review before final hiring decisions.

ablation.description: Exact JD term overlap only; useful as a control, but vulnerable to keyword stuffing and missing transferable evidence.
Local semantic concept layer tied to Redrob JD concepts: retrieval, ranking, evaluation, production ML, ownership, and LLM depth.
Vector similarity layer embeds the JD and candidate profile into the same normalized vector space before hybrid ranking.
Final score combines semantic fit, structured evidence, production proof, ranking/evaluation depth, behavior, availability, penalties, and proxy guardrails.

evidenceBackedDecisions.decision: Use hybrid semantic plus structured ranking instead of keyword-only filters.
evidenceBackedDecisions.dataPoint: The Redrob JD asks for embeddings, hybrid retrieval, LLM re-ranking, evaluation, and production shipping; the dataset has profile text, history, skills, and behavioral signals.
evidenceBackedDecisions.implementation: Semantic concept fit and vector similarity are scored separately and blended with technical evidence, production proof, role domain, ranking/evaluation depth, and capped behavioral signals.

evidenceBackedDecisions.dataPoint: Recruiter response, response time, notice period, salary, and work mode have 100% coverage, but they can act as proxy shortcuts if overweighted.
evidenceBackedDecisions.implementation: Behavior and availability contribute only 12% of the raw hybrid score together, and proxyGuardrail subtracts lift when job evidence is weak.

evidenceBackedDecisions.dataPoint: GitHub activity appears for only part of the dataset and skill assessments are sparse, so using them as hard filters would exclude many candidates unfairly.
evidenceBackedDecisions.implementation: GitHub and assessments are optional evidence boosts, never required gates.

evidenceBackedDecisions.decision: Keep challenge ranking CPU-only and network-off.
evidenceBackedDecisions.dataPoint: The official submission spec caps runtime, memory, CPU use, and network access.
evidenceBackedDecisions.implementation: The local vector and semantic layers run without API calls; an optional Transformers.js reranker can rerank winner pools when a local model is available.

evidenceBackedDecisions.decision: Let ranking improve from recruiter review behavior.
evidenceBackedDecisions.dataPoint: Great recruiters reward production proof, role-specific depth, and evaluation discipline more than raw activity or keyword density.
evidenceBackedDecisions.implementation: The score now includes a review-informed evidence component, and the UI captures per-candidate recruiter feedback locally for future preference weighting.
